description: Codex case 1 (NO-GO of the commit that made lexical scope exact, a regression against main): Python binds `__class__` implicitly in every method of a class (the data model's implicit closure cell), so `__class__()` inside `test_adds` is the class `TestA`, not the module's `from pytest import skip as __class__`. TG003 warns that it may skip the test, never FAIL; the real runner runs it.
